messages:
alex: opened PR #4127 — adjusts SA scopes and secret handling for the on-prem VPC rollout. planning to land this into the merge queue tomorrow AM unless there are security concerns. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4127 :link:
sasha: thanks alex. quick Q — does this change the k8s secret mount behavior or just how we fetch from Vault/KMS? :thinking_face:
owen: flagging potential network implications: the new agent polls metadata endpoint more frequently. need to ensure it stays inside the VPC egress rules. can you paste the config?
alex: good call. it only changes the retrieval flow: we move from in-node file-based secret to a short-lived token fetched at pod start. no filesystem writes. snippet:

```yaml
# deployment snippet from the PR
env:
  - name: VAULT_TOKEN_PATH
    value: "/var/run/creds/token" # used only in dev, removed for onprem
  - name: VAULT_ROLE
    value: "redwood-agent-onprem"
```

We also add an initContainer that calls the internal agent to request a token (uses k8s service account token mounting).
maria: can you confirm the token lifetime and whether it's rotated automatically? also is the token scoped to the pod SA or a broader role?
alex: token TTL is 15m, rotated by the agent every 10m. scoped to the pod SA with minimal perms (read-only for secrets/*/runtime).
sec-bot: static-scan: no secrets detected in PR diff. dependency-scan: ok. policy-check: requires manual review for authz scope change (rule: onprem-authz-scope).
tim: @sasha @owen can we do a quick checklist before approving? I suggest: 1) confirm no broad SA perms, 2) egress rules cover agent calls, 3) update runbook for breakglass.
sasha: i'll pick 1 & 3. will skim the role binding in the PR.
owen: i'll validate egress config in staging (should be a 30min smoke). ETA EOD.
maria: if you want faster review, add a short note in the PR description summarizing token TTL, RBAC binding, and rollback steps.
alex: done — updated PR desc with TTL and rollback steps. added logs filter for agent to reduce noise.
sasha: skimmed RBAC, LGTM but leaving a small comment about narrowing the role name. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: manual-queue: added sec-review label and assigned to eng-security oncall.
mar​ia: small nit — please ensure audit logging is enabled for the secret access path (so we can trace reads).
alex: yep, audit logging is enabled via our Vault proxy in onprem. linked the config in the PR.
tim: sounds good. if owens smoke test passes today we can land tomorrow morning. @alex please slot for merge queue and set a short canary (5 pods) post-merge. :white_check_mark:
sec-bot: deploy-preview: staging smoke job queued by CI (job id: 7823).
alex: thanks everyone — i'll wait for owens confirmation and then queue the merge. :pray:
